An '''energy cycler''' was a component used in the [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]. Four energy cyclers were installed in the weapon, and the components helped to create and focus the high-energy [[Particle beam/Legends|particle beam]] in conjunction with twelve [[refinement tube]]s and four low-grade [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]].<ref name="EGWT" />
